narr: Heavy bands of rain moved along a slow moving cold front on the morning of the 26th. These bands produced locally heavy rainfall across portions of the central Midlands. Rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches fell in a 1 to 2 hour period across downtown Columbia. This produced rapid rises along many of the area creeks including Rocky Branch.
ev: City of Columbia Police reported the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street flooded. Areas along Rocky Branch were flooded from the intersection of Blossom Street and Pickens Street. This also includes areas along Maxcy Gregg Park. The USGS stream gage at the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street crested at 8.6 feet. Flood stage is 7.2 feet.
lsr: FLOODING ON ROCKY BRANCH CRREK. MAIN AND WHALEY STREET. ROAD IMPASSABLE.
